name: Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) API
tagline: Search and annotate rare-disease phenotypes with the Human Phenotype Ontology.
description: JAX-hosted REST service for searching HPO terms, retrieving term records, and traversing ancestor, parent, child, and descendant relationships. Disease, gene, and medical-action annotations are provided through the separate Ontology Annotation Network API.

auth.details: No authentication required for public endpoints; open read access without API keys.

example.response_snippet: {"terms":[{"id":"HP:0001250","name":"Seizure","definition":"A seizure is an intermittent abnormality of nervous system physiology characterized by a transient occurrence of signs and/or symptoms due to abnormal excessive or synchronous neuronal activity in the brain.","synonyms":["Epilepsy","Epileptic seizure","Seizures"]}],"totalCount":1}

use_cases: search HPO phenotype terms by keyword
look up an HPO term by ID with definition and synonyms
retrieve parent/child hierarchy for a phenotype term
annotate patient phenotypes with standard HPO IDs
find diseases associated with a given phenotype
